name: lesson-island-cloudflare
description: Cloudflare Worker that hosts Lesson Island, with optional teacher sign-in and subscriptions.

scripts.dev:features: npm run site && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env staging && wrangler dev --env staging
scripts.deploy: npm run site && npm run upload-large && wrangler deploy --env="" && npm run db:migrate
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run site && npm run upload-large && wrangler deploy --env staging && npm run db:migrate:staging
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
